The last marks that A performed the action under their own volition.

Absolutive is unmarked (-Ø) in Matis. Both S and O bear no case marker. Ergative A is marked with -n.
Matis 1st person singular pronouns follow ergative alignment: A=embi, S/O=ebi. The 1+2 inclusive nuki/muki is neutral (invariant).

Matis 2nd person singular follows ergative alignment (A=mimbi, S/O=mibi), but 2nd person plural follows ACCUSATIVE alignment: mikui in A/S position, mitso in O position. So there is a singular/plural split: singular=ergative, plural=accusative.

Matis 3rd person singular non-emphatic is Ø (neutral). 3rd person plural non-emphatic: Ø in A/S, ato in O — accusative alignment. 4th person (emphatic/coreferential): akui in A/S, ato in O — accusative alignment. Overall, 3rd person pronouns do NOT follow ergative alignment.
Full NPs in Matis follow strict ergative-absolutive case marking: A marked with -n (ERG), S and O unmarked (-Ø, ABS). See ex. (1a,b): dëndu-n 'electric.eel-ERG', tumi-Ø 'man's.name-ABS'.
